name: Senzu Bean
description: Once per battle, automatically restores 30% max HP when falling below 30% HP.

name: Dragon Scale
description: Reduces all incoming physical attack damage by 15%.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: Grants a 10% dodge chance against all incoming attacks.

name: Warrior's Resolve
description: If hit by an attack that would inflict lethal damage from full HP, survives with 1 HP instead. (Once per battle)

name: Energy Flask
description: Regenerates +15 extra energy automatically at the end of every turn.
